headerConfig.subject: Cambridge Multi-Discipline Orientation
headerConfig.instructions: Answer all 10 questions. Test each on-screen tool: Periodic Table (Q1), Scientific Calculator (Q2), Audio Player (Q3), Leaf Anatomy Diagram (Q4), Resource Booklet (Q5), Data Table (Q6), Multi-Select (Q7), Inline Cloze (Q8), Arabic RTL (Q9), and Bahasa Indonesia (Q10). Do not press Esc, Alt+Tab, or F11 during the examination.
